doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: On the road with Ida Cox
summary: About twelve years earlier Billie went on the road with Ida Cox, picking up musicians near Biloxi.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: I was on the road with Ida about, when long Papa been dead? How long look like I been dead? Oh, I can't hear. How long, honey, old man been dead? About ten years? About ten years. About twelve years ago I was on the road with Ida. About twelve years ago. Yeah, yeah, yeah. About twelve years ago. Who had the band then? Myself from there, I know. Me too.
We had the band from here. And who was in that band?
Paul. Paul didn't go with us.

Me and you and Ernest left, and we were in the water. And we picked up some musicians over the lake. Somewhere over the lake there. Remember where it was? I'm trying to think who it was, the rest of the music was over the lake there. left in the water and we picked up some musicians over the lake, somewhere over the lake there. I'm trying to think who it was, the rest of the musicians was over the lake there. Over the Biloxi somewhere I believe we picked up. A drummer? We picked up a drummer something from Biloxi.
Who is this William that was a drummer? Oh yeah William worked with me.
I saw William, they were here to the past.
What's his name? Is this William? William all I know.

You know him don't you? No. Where did you work with him? He cut some records up there. He cut records with us. He worked with me and Lutton, a spot like that. Oh wait a minute let me see if I got William a picture. I saw William passed one day this week. No one day last week, Friday 31. I think Saeed's on some records. It was Saeed's brother. He's Saeed with William a brother ain't he? Ain't he brother Saeed William? I think they all brother. They're brother they look like talking like shorty brother William. Me too. We have Saeed. And he always write over here to me bump back this way all the time. See he bump back. We have Saeed. We have Saeed. People got me to meet them I guess. Tape.
